items.title: IREN (NasdaqGS:IREN) Objects To Tokenized Share Trading On New Blockchain Venue
items.summary: IREN (NasdaqGS:IREN) has formally objected to tokenized trading of its shares on the new ICE/OKX blockchain stock platform. The objection aligns IREN with companies including Nvidia, Costco, and Nike in challenging unauthorized tokenization of their equity. These issuers are citing an SEC exemptive order that they say restricts tokenized trading of their stocks without explicit consent.
